description: plate [0,0,0]–[100,100,10] minus two blind pockets open on its top, [20,40]×[20,40] and [40,60]×[40,60], both z 5 to 10: the tools' tops coincident with the plate's top, the pockets touching along the line x = 40, y = 40, where the plate's two remaining quadrants meet in an edge of four faces, which a manifold solid does not hold — Arris refuses with OpError::Degenerate and Reason::NonManifold naming the edge, as edge-touching-fuse does
